items.text:
subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the uploaded 地理 reference at order 1. <Subject 1> is the cramped downstairs artist studio in <Picture 1>, with stacked frames, rough work surfaces, a low ceiling, and dense painter's clutter. <Picture 2> is the accepted opening frame for [Shot 1], fixing the approved starting composition, visible positions, and initial state for this shot.
summary: [keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a single vertical period-drama shot in the early-1900s New York artist-apartment world. Wet shoes, lantern, ladder, brushes, and paint assemble the physical evidence of the night. The opening is anchored by <Picture 2> and preserves <Subject 1>.
retention_analysis: <Picture 1> (reference image order 1): fully_preserved - its 地理 role is retained as the input reference for this shot. <Picture 2> (opening frame of [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the supplied starting composition, visible placement, and initial state open the shot. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - stacked frames, rough work surfaces, a low ceiling, and dense painter's clutter remain stable; the approved motion changes only the shot's stated action and endpoint.
detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. The shot begins from <Picture 2>, with <Subject 1> providing the cold cluttered studio around the accepted prop arrangement. Sue (S2) continues in an off-screen voiceover. At 0.00 to 1.80 seconds the camera glides from the dripping work shoes and wet dark coat. From 1.80 to 3.40 seconds it moves to the lantern that still carries a trace of light. From 3.40 to 5.00 seconds it passes the narrow ladder leaning against the wall. From 5.00 to 6.40 seconds it reveals scattered brushes. At 6.40 to 8.00 seconds it settles on the shallow palette where green and yellow paint touch. Sue's off-screen voiceover says: <d>[Chinese] 门房说，他被发现时，鞋和衣服全湿透了。屋里有一盏还亮着的提灯。还有一架从楼下拖走的梯子，几支散开的画笔，一盘调好的绿色和黄色颜料。</d> Keep all objects in the same downstairs geography and use connected camera movement with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment.
overall_soundscape: Cold studio room tone, water dripping from cloth and shoes, a lantern wick hiss, wood and brush contact, and the off-screen voiceover carried through the object sequence.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
